name: mRNA
oneLine: A working copy of one gene, sent to the ribosomes.
howItWorks: A gene is copied from DNA into mRNA. The ribosome reads it from start to stop. Then it is broken down, so the cell only makes what is needed now.
deeper: In bacteria an mRNA lasts only minutes. Ribosomes can start reading it before the copy is even finished.
sizeComparison: a 300th the width of a hair
simplification: We show short messages; real ones are a thousand letters or more.
